description: This source file contains unit tests for the 'WindowPlacement' utility, testing positioning functions such as centeredFrame, topRightFrame, and window placement on screen within a macOS application. It verifies fallback behaviors, clamping to bounds, and on-screen placement using the AppKit framework.

methods.name: centeredFrame
methods.description: Calculates a centered window frame within given bounds or falls back to origin if bounds are zero.

methods.name: topRightFrame
methods.description: Calculates a top-right window frame within bounds with optional padding, fallback to origin if bounds are zero.

methods.name: ensureOnScreen
methods.description: Adjusts window position to ensure it is on screen, using fallback positioning if necessary.
